correctness.rationale: The proof uses only the source equations. Cancellation gives an exact quadratic in the predator coordinate with one positive root for every prey value in (0,K); substitution then gives the exact attack-rate parameterization. The boundary limit equals the prey-invasion eigenvalue threshold. The small-prey asymptotic has a positive leading coefficient and the determinant has a strictly negative leading term. The checker independently evaluates the source parameter set and original equilibrium residuals.
